title: Iterate narrowly, then run the attached full CI gate once
when: Before remote pytest iteration or the final review gate.
need: Targeted files/node IDs and bounded impacted selection support iteration. Each impacted run in a lane first brings the lane current with origin/<base> through the gate's own update; uncommitted work or a conflict refuses with the named reason and recovery and runs no tests. An unfiltered request covering every declared test root duplicates an available registered full CI gate and refuses before publication/dispatch. Follow the named attached requirement or its lookup for full verification; keep its native verdict. A conflicting landing PR with no covering run refuses before rebase: merge the base into the lane, resolve and commit, then let the normal gate publish the repaired head and rerun. An explicit expected SHA is checked before preparation; a clean gate base update becomes the verified candidate and evidence retains the requested SHA. Merge-shaped lanes merge the fetched base without replaying resolved commits; linear lanes rebase. A conflicting merge aborts, lists the actual paths and teaches merging the base on the lane, resolving and rerunning. Empty effective keyword/marker expressions are unfiltered; nonempty filters and collection keep their routes.
surface: Wrapper help, routing refusal and verification rules
review: Source and fixture coverage only; post-deploy Command proof must exercise the candidate router with fake dispatch boundaries.
